questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the path of the first blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (4, 1), then bit at (5, 2), then ramp_right at (6, 3), then ramp_left at (7, 4), then ramp_right at (6, 5), then ramp_left at (7, 6), then ramp_right at (6, 7), then ramp_left at (7, 8), then ramp_right at (6, 9), and is caught at the right exit.

questions.question: What is the output pattern after running the machine?
questions.answer: 16 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left. 8 exit left, 8 exit right, 0 are intercepted.

questions.question: How does the bit create the alternating color pattern?
questions.answer: The bit starts pointing right. Blue ball #1 lands on the bit, goes right to trigger the right lever, releasing a red ball. The bit flips to point left. Red ball #1 goes to the left lever, triggers blue ball #2. The bit flips again, and so on.
